metadata.name: Viz
metadata.displayName: jui viz: watch your agents work
metadata.description: Tools > jui viz. The local browser view of Claude Code sessions and subagents (rooms and robots), shipped in jsonui-cli 2.0.0. The page opens with the live demo (VizDemo, the folder `jui viz export-demo` writes), then ten sections: what it shows / what you need / install / start / reading the screen / permission prompts / test progress / remove / troubleshooting / safety. Source: the article the jui viz side handed over, checked against jsonui-cli 2.0.0; the reading-the-screen section re-read at 2.1.0 (doors and the one-room view, the background state, the spec board across apps, a task card per instruction).

customComponents.name: VizDemo
customComponents.description: The jui viz demo in an iframe.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Seed nextReadLinks from the static catalog (two rows: next_cli -> /tools/cli, next_agents -> /tools/agents). Each row's titleKey / descriptionKey is resolved through StringManager with the tools_viz_ namespace prefix.

methods.name: onNavigate
methods.description: Client-side navigation via router.push(url). Destinations are the spec-mapped URLs enumerated in transitions: /tools, /tools/cli, /tools/agents.

vars.name: nextReadLinks
vars.description: Two closing 'read next' cards pointing at /tools/cli and /tools/agents. Seeded on appear and re-seeded on a language change.

notes: The demo is served from jsonui-doc-web/public/tools/viz-demo/<jsonui-cli version>/, written by `jui viz export-demo` from the pinned jsonui-cli. Re-export on a pin bump that changes it; see the VizDemo component spec.
The jui viz screen is Japanese only (checked at 2.1.0). The English page says so under the demo.
